title: About the Entra ID Issue Safelist

blocks.text: After you scan an Entra ID tenant, the issues are listed under the Focus Areas section on the Entra ID dashboard. You can review these issues to confirm that they are not a risk and mark them as safe.
Adding issues to the safelist impacts the unified risk score on the Entra ID dashboard.
The Entra ID Issue Safelist provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View the list of issues that don't pose a risk and are marked safe.
Ensure that the risk score on the Entra ID dashboard reflects the actual risk.

blocks.heading: About the Entra ID Issue Safelist Page

blocks.text: On the Entra ID Issue Safelist page (ITDR > Settings > Entra ID Issue Safelist), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select an Entra ID tenant from the Result for drop-down menu.
View the list of issues that are marked safe. For each issue, you can view:
Name: The name of the issue.
Created On: The date when the issue was added to the safelist.
Created By: The name of the user who added the issue to the safelist.
Reason: The reason why the issue was added to the safelist.
Delete an issue from the safelist.
